sources.name: Pocket Archives
sources.note: Canonical for SKU, physical location, scans, and reviewed card facts.

sources.name: eBay Seller API
sources.note: Read-only intelligence uses the existing sanitized account snapshots.

sources.name: eBay Browse API
sources.note: Discovery evidence only. Active asks are never treated as realized sales.

sources.name: eBay sold history
sources.note: BUY and high-confidence market values stay disabled until an approved realized-sales feed succeeds.

sources.name: TCGplayer
sources.note: TCGplayer's API remains available to existing key holders, but it is not granting new developer access. No Pocket Archives key is configured.

sources.name: TCGCSV
sources.note: Daily TCGplayer-derived catalog and market-price cache. Supporting price-guide evidence only, not realized sold comps.

sources.name: Scryfall
sources.note: Exact-printing support for Magic. Prices are supporting guide evidence, not Pocket Archives realized sales.

sources.name: Pokémon TCG API
sources.note: Useful for English Pokémon identity and set matching. Language, variant, finish, and condition still require Pocket Archives review.

sources.name: YGOPRODeck
sources.note: Exact name plus set-code verification for Yu-Gi-Oh!; physical finish and condition still require scan evidence.

sources.name: PriceCharting
sources.note: Supporting current guide only; its API/CSV does not supply realized historical sales.

sources.name: PSA
sources.note: Use exact cert verification manually until approved automation access exists.

sources.name: CGC
sources.note: CGC population is evidence of supply, not proof of value.

sources.name: TAG
sources.note: No approved bulk integration is configured.

sources.name: Card Ladder
sources.note: No public API was found. Current terms prohibit automated collection without express written consent, so Pocket Archives will not scrape it.

sources.name: Collectr
sources.note: Portfolio estimates are not realized comps.

sources.name: TCGIndex
sources.note: Authoritative access and commercial-use terms have not been verified.

sources.name: Whatnot
sources.note: Use Pocket Archives exports for own transactions; not a general market-price feed.
